description: Frozen direct-boundary baseline for the WebUI internal dependency check, measured before any migration (plan section 7.5). Each entry is one violating file pair. `stage` is the migration stage after which the entry must be deleted; deleting it is enforced because a baseline entry that is no longer violated fails the check.

entries.reason: A server operation module imports runtime implementation. Stage 3 rewires the operation layer to register typed bindings instead of calling the runner/profile implementation, so the edge disappears then.

The dedicated runCommand handler interprets a slash command by calling runtime/commands/runner.ts. Stage 3 moved the operation layer from the forwarding handler map to typed bindings, but runCommand is one of the 13 operations that keeps a dedicated handler because it shapes a handled/unhandled result over several port calls. The server -> runtime edge therefore follows the code to its new home instead of disappearing; it is the same exception as before, relocated, exactly like the agent-memory.ts -> profile-files.ts pair.

cycles.reason: Stream frame reduction and stream instrumentation reference each other. Stage 4 separates stream lease/loop mechanisms from the projection state, removing the back edge.
Two React components reference each other. Stage 6 finalises the presentation boundary and removes the reciprocal import.

allowances.reason: Node subprocess entry point loads its bundled embedded CLI through a URL object, not a statically resolvable specifier. It is a Node executable entry, not part of the browser or server module graph.
